claims.text: Royal Order A/255 dated 26/9/1438 AH, issued that day according to the dateline Makkah 26 Ramadan 1438 / 21 June 2017: item First relieves Prince Mohammed bin Nayef bin Abdulaziz of the crown princeship and of the posts of Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Interior.
claims.locator: Dateline; order number and date; item First; trailer (filed 06:23 Makkah time)
claims.uncertainty: A relief by royal order. The recital refers to justifications reviewed by the Allegiance Commission members without stating them.

claims.text: Item Second of the same order selects Prince Mohammed bin Salman bin Abdulaziz as Crown Prince and appoints him Deputy Prime Minister, continuing as Minister of Defence and in the other tasks assigned to him.
claims.uncertainty: The order states no effective date, and no end of his crown-princeship is recorded in this packet.

claims.text: The order's recital rests on the justifications reviewed by the Allegiance Commission members and on their support by a great majority, 31 of 34.
claims.uncertainty: A recital in the royal order, not a record published by the Commission.

claims.text: The recital of Royal Order A/255 (Arabic original, and likewise SPA's English translation) dates Royal Order A/160 10/6/1436 AH. The 2015 A/160 original, A/159 and the Royal Court pledge call all read 10/7/1436 AH (29 April 2015). The 29 April 2015 date is kept, and 10/6 is recorded as an error in the 2017 order text as SPA published it.
claims.uncertainty: The error is in the published 2017 order text, not an English translation error. The Umm al-Qura gazette text of A/255 was not checked.

scope_note: Arabic original of the 21 June 2017 order (also served at legacy SPA IDs from 1641876), located by the packet's independent checker. SPA's English release (sa_spa_order_a255_20170621_en) is its translation and prints no order number. The release ends with 'to follow'; the other orders issued that day are not imported. Used for SA-EXEC-07.
